hypothesis: Receipt-delivered, bounded task-distinctive source acquisition plus a guarded source-read finish path improves ContextBench final-source accuracy while reducing known model tokens and duration against native convergence across four fresh language/repository strata.
selection_rule: For each of the four language/repository strata, exclude G01 task IDs already in frozen configurations or source-only inputs, sort remaining IDs by SHA-256, then choose the first title containing a code-like identifier (backticks, an HTML tag, underscores, a double-hyphen flag, or internal camel-case capitalization) whose base commit exists in the pinned repository cache. Read only the eight source-only parquet columns; never gold_context, patch, or test_patch.
decision_rule: Run and report all four frozen tasks regardless of earlier outcomes. Seal each matched pair before pinned native scoring. An aggregate campaign pass requires all four pairs scoreable, candidate macro-mean Span-F1 and File-F1 both strictly above control, summed known model tokens and summed measured duration both strictly below control, and no more than one task with lower Span-F1. Report every task regression and validity failure; a later source or task change begins a new campaign.
claim_ceiling: Four-task cross-language G01 replication for the distinctive-source arm only; not full ContextBench or cross-benchmark ARE product proof.
